name.en: Caste Certificate (Integrated Certificate: Caste, Nativity, DOB)

department: Revenue (Tahsildar / revenue officials) via Swarna Gramam and Swarna Wardu services
summary: In Andhra Pradesh the caste certificate is issued as an Integrated Certificate (Caste, Nativity, Date of Birth) to SC, ST, BC and OC applicants. It is used for education, employment and welfare schemes such as scholarships.

eligibility.who: AP resident belonging to SC, ST, BC or OC community

documents.name: Application form
documents.if_missing: Get the form from the portal or village/ward secretariat

documents.name: Caste certificate already issued to a family member
documents.if_missing: Ask the secretariat what is accepted instead

documents.name: SSC marks memo, DOB extract or transfer certificate
documents.if_missing: Get a duplicate from the school or board

documents.name: Study certificates (Class 1 to 10) or DOB certificate from the GP/Municipal authority
documents.if_missing: Ask the school or the panchayat/municipality

documents.name: Ration card, EPIC (voter) card or Aadhaar card
documents.if_missing: Use any one of the three

documents.name: Schedule I to IV (format listed by the department)
documents.why: Declaration schedules required by the department
documents.if_missing: Ask the secretariat for the format

upload_rules: Documents are uploaded as PDFs on the portal
steps: Open the AP Seva portal (apseva.ap.gov.in) and log in as a citizen, or go to your village/ward secretariat
Select the Caste / Integrated Certificate service under Revenue
Upload the supporting documents as PDFs
Pay any charge online, if the portal asks
Submit; revenue officials verify it (Tahsildar level)
Track the status on the portal and download the digitally signed certificate
fee_note: To confirm. Older MeeSeva-based pages say Rs 10. The AP Seva portal sets a charge per service, and the department text I found was unclear.

processing.note: AP government SOP lists 7 days for first-time issue (partly readable). One guide says 15-30 days. Confirm on the portal.

sources: AP government SOP document (vswsonline.ap.gov.in), partly readable
Srikakulam district site (srikakulam.ap.gov.in) - Integrated Certificate page
Guide sites: bankbazaar, indiafilings, beincareer, anantamias (unofficial)
